name: Input Finder and Text Inserter
description: Finds editable accessibility nodes and inserts or clears text through supported accessibility actions.
permissions: Android Accessibility Service must be enabled by the user.
inputs: Accessibility root node; text to insert or clear.
outputs: Editable node or null; boolean result for clear/insert actions.
limits: Search is bounded by node count and elapsed time; target app must expose an editable node.
tests: Editable-node selection and text-action tests are pending; manual device verification is required.
limitations: Text insertion depends on the target app exposing an editable accessibility node and supporting ACTION_SET_TEXT.
No fixed screen coordinate should be used to locate or focus the input field.
